judged_text: The new behavior that a stored host with no category falls back to uncategorized, and that host matching is case-insensitive via lower(host), has no test — embeddable_host_spec.rb covers only protocol/path trimming and exact-case host_allowed? against 'eviltrout.com'. The `where("lower(host) = ?", host)` lookup is never exercised with a referer host containing uppercase (e.g., 'http://EvilTrout.com/'), which the old SiteSetting comparison would have rejected; embed sites with mixed-case hostnames could be broken or wrongly accepted with no failing test. Checked spec/models/embeddable_host_spec.rb — only lowercase URLs are tested.

adjudication.rationale: The diff adds two pieces of nontrivial behavior without direct test coverage: (1) category fallback to uncategorized in `Admin::EmbeddableHostsController#save_host` (`host.category_id = SiteSetting.uncategorized_category_id if host.category_id.blank?`) is not asserted anywhere; and (2) host lookup logic changed to use SQL `where("lower(host) = ?", host)` in `EmbeddableHost.record_for_host`, but `spec/models/embeddable_host_spec.rb` only exercises lowercase URLs (e.g. `http://eviltrout.com`) and does not cover mixed/uppercase host inputs or explicitly verify the intended case-insensitive behavior. This is a concrete, diff-grounded missing-edge-case test concern rather than a proven functional defect from the diff alone.
